description: Sends a booking request to the Platinumride team. Use it only after the customer has chosen a route and agreed to the Terms of Service (https://platinumride.com/terms). Do not use it for browsing or quotes; use search_routes and get_route_details for that. Each call sends a new inquiry and is not idempotent, so never call it twice for the same request. Limit: 3 inquiries per connection every 10 minutes. Returns an inquiry reference and a WhatsApp follow-up link to share with the customer. This is not a confirmed booking: the team confirms availability and the final price.

agreedToTerms.description: Required. true only if the customer has read and agreed to the Terms of Service at https://platinumride.com/terms. The inquiry is rejected otherwise.

customerEmail.description: Customer email address. Give this or customerWhatsApp (at least one is required).

customerName.description: Required. Customer's full name, one line.

customerWhatsApp.description: WhatsApp number with country code in E.164 format, no spaces, e.g. '+971501234567'. Give this or customerEmail (at least one is required).

date.description: Required. Travel date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '2026-12-20'. Must be today or later in UAE time.

dropoffAddress.description: Optional. Drop-off address, hotel or airport.

luggage.description: Optional. Number of large suitcases, 0 to 30. Helps the team pick a vehicle.

notes.description: Optional. Free text for the team: children and child seats, extra stops, special luggage, return trip or other requests.

passengers.description: Required. Total passengers including children, 1 to 7.

pickupAddress.description: Optional. Pickup address, hotel or airport. Add the flight number for airport pickups.

routeSlug.description: Required. Exact route slug from search_routes or get_route_details, e.g. 'dubai-to-riyadh-private-transfer'.

time.description: Optional. Preferred local pickup time in 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. '07:30'.

vehicleTier.description: Optional. Tier name from the route's price tiers, e.g. 'Premium SUV'. Case-insensitive. Omit if the customer has not chosen.

name: create_inquiry
title: Send a booking inquiry
